verdict_text:
YES

The script computes `delta = B @ A` in float32, applies no transpose (`fan_in_fan_out = false`), adds `2.0 * delta` to the float32-upcast base weight and casts back to float16, for all 16 layers of `attention.query_key_value`; adapter tensors are never inserted into the state dict, so the key set stays at the base's 244 names and every other tensor is written back bit-exact. All four required checks are asserted before writing, and the greedy packer flushes before a tensor would push a shard past 536,870,912 bytes of tensor data (placing any single oversized tensor alone), emitting `model-XXXXX-of-YYYYY.safetensors` shards plus a `model.safetensors.index.json` whose `weight_map` covers every tensor.
note: experimenter: set `detected` (true if the stated problem matches expected_defect; for a correct artifact, true means a false alarm). verdict none = no answer, excluded from rates.
